extracted.intended_audience: new inventors, small businesses, entrepreneurs, and first-time patent applicants
extracted.subtask_description: An introductory, practical guide to what patents are and the steps to apply for, obtain, and manage patent rights with the USPTO; aimed at people who know little or nothing about patents. Covers application steps (representation, deadlines, fees), searching, types of patents/applications, examination, and post‑grant management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent essentials
rubrics_metrics.description: High-level introduction to what a patent is and the essential things someone who knows nothing about patents needs to know.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overview landing content that orients absolute beginners to the scope of patent topics covered by the USPTO site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic questions about patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Answers to foundational questions about patents (e.g., what is a patent?).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to clarify basic concepts and terminology for newcomers; provides simple explanatory material rather than procedural detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Foreign patents and treaties
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about patent protection outside the United States and international treaty frameworks affecting patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance to help inventors understand cross‑border protection and options for filing abroad.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and assistance available to inventors (help programs, guidance, training).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points inventors to services and programs intended to help through the patenting process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Functions of the agency
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of USPTO roles and responsibilities in the patent system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what the agency does (examines applications, issues patents, provides tools/services).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying for patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Section that dives into how to apply for a patent, covering procedural essentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically notes topics such as legal representation, deadlines, fees, and other essential parts of the application process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal representation
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on the role and use of attorneys and agents when filing patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains considerations for hiring or using registered patent practitioners versus pro se filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about key filing and prosecution deadlines relevant to patent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights that timing requirements are critical in patent practice and that applicants must track deadlines carefully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about USPTO fees associated with filing and prosecuting patent applications and maintaining patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains fee types and the need to budget for filing, examination, and maintenance costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and tools for searching existing patents and published applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages prior art searching as part of evaluating whether to pursue a patent and to prepare applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attorneys and agents
rubrics_metrics.description: Information identifying and explaining patent attorneys and agents and how to work with them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers qualifications, roles, and how to find or contact registered practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of different patent categories (e.g., utility, design, plant).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps inventors determine which patent type best fits their invention.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of application forms and paths (e.g., provisional, nonprovisional, PCT/International filings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains differences and strategic considerations for choosing an application type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination process
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of how patent applications are examined by the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers the overall process and what applicants should expect during prosecution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ready to file
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and checklists to help applicants prepare to file a patent application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical steps and preparatory advice to ensure filings are complete and timely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Managing your patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for what to do after a patent is granted, including maintenance and enforcement of rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers lifecycle management topics such as paying maintenance fees, enforcing rights, transferring ownership, and correcting records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nature of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanation of what patent rights are and what they entitle the owner to do (or prevent others from doing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies the legal scope and limitations of patent rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent marking
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on marking products or documents to indicate patent protection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains legal/policy reasons for marking and how it affects enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Term extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on extending patent term in limited circumstances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains eligibility and procedures for seeking extensions (e.g., regulatory delays).

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Details about periodic fees required to keep a granted patent in force.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains fee schedules and consequences of nonpayment (lapse).

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for correcting errors in issued patents or application records.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes mechanisms (e.g., certificates of correction) to fix mistakes in documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about patent ownership and how rights are held.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discusses inventorship, assignment, and recordation considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignments and licenses
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on transferring patent rights by assignment or licensing them to others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers basic transaction types and the importance of recordation with the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infringement
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of what constitutes patent infringement and options for enforcement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes enforcement concepts and next steps if rights are violated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Helpful resources for new customers
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional resources, tools, events, and programs targeted at first‑time patent filers and small inventors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes links to events, videos (e.g., Path to a Patent sessions), pro bono programs, and online tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access free patent services
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on free or low‑cost services available to eligible inventors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points to pro bono programs and support resources for those who qualify.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review online patent tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Encouragement to use USPTO online tools for searching, filing, and managing patents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Directs users to electronic resources that assist with various patent tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of the patent process
rubrics_metrics.description: High‑level walkthrough of the stages from identifying an invention to filing, examination, grant, and post‑grant management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as a roadmap for newcomers to understand the sequence of steps and choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify if you have a patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Tools and guidance to help individuals determine whether an invention qualifies for patent protection or whether they already have patent rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A diagnostic/triage step for potential applicants to decide on next actions.
